# Bid the posts and the gates, not the linear feet.

> Price a fence installation from posts, terminals, gates, tear-out, and digging conditions. See installed price per foot, effective hourly rate, and the walk-away number before you send the bid.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
